g.title: Rectangle
g.text: R1(config)#ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.1.5.1!router ospf 1 router-id 1.1.1.1 default-information originate

g.title: Sheet.370
g.text: At every flap of the ISP connection:- R1 floods a Type 5 LSA to inform remote routers to remove the default route.- Subsequently, every router run the SPF algorithm even though from data-plane point of view, nothing changes.
